title: THE CHARACTER STUDY
passages: By July, I had a name for what I was doing: a character study of my own life. The wins, the failures, the mentors, the adventures, the relationships, the style, the creative experiments.

Watching myself was helping me understand myself. Technology could support that attention: cameras, ideas captured before they disappeared, tools that made room to create. Video editing could be a place to move through emotion. The work was becoming a record I could return to and recognize.
